description: within's own guides for a question: journal notes (how a designer's sizes run, where to shop in a city, what to wear to an occasion, how to tell real from fake) and edits (items picked around one idea). Give the question in plain words; up to five come back, each with its title, one line and its shopwithin.co link. Use this when someone asks a how, which or is-it-worth-it question about designer fashion.
